title: Temporal Scaling
description: EEG recordings from twenty participants who learned three temporal intervals (short, medium, long). Two randomly interleaved subtasks were used: a Production task, in which participants produced a target interval, and a Perception task, in which they judged whether a computer-generated interval was correct. Visual feedback (checkmark or x) followed both tasks. The dataset supports investigation of temporal scaling of human scalp-recorded potentials.
methods_description: Participants learned three temporal intervals and performed interleaved Production and Perception subtasks. In Production, they produced a short, medium, or long interval. In Perception, they judged a computer-produced interval as correct or incorrect. Visual feedback was given after each trial.
